definingAcademicObject: Scientific investigation of human language by relating linguistic theories/analysis to empirical neuro-/psycholinguistic evidence. The formal outcomes name syntax,semantics,pragmatics,phonology/phonetics,processing/acquisition and their integration, not general cognition or effective communication alone.

actualCurrentContent.finding: Phonetic transcription/phonological rules, diagnostic syntactic analysis and annotation, semantics with logic and empirical acquisition/processing links, language-theoretic child acquisition and historical/contact change establish sustained analysis of language systems.

Speech/language disorders relate structural linguistic domains to development and acquired brain injury; processing combines properties of language with cognitive-neuroscientific experiments. Neuroimaging covers EEG/eye-tracking and evaluation of their adequacy for linguistic questions, explicitly not independent experiment competence at first-year level. Dyslexia centers reading/spelling as secondary language functions with cognitive,behavioural,diagnostic and neural approaches.

Clinical work includes child/adult language-test interpretation and spontaneous-speech analysis using linguistic profiles/models. Phonology tests theories against acoustic/phonetic evidence; syntax investigates generative grammatical structures; formal semantics includes compositionality,lambda calculus,intensionality and interfaces; pragmatics combines theory,experimental inquiry and disorder evidence.

Selected portfolio work includes language-processing ERP/DES experiment design/validation; own small study of developmental language disorders integrating formal and neuropsycholinguistic perspectives; supervised empirical/theoretical syntactic inquiry. Allthree must pass; unroundedmean>=5.5. With Syntax selected its final assignment is written; other seminars supply poster and presentation.

Other genuine portfolio options investigate phonological representation/theory or theoretical-experimental sem/prag and clinical disorders; not selected as extra credits. HumaneAI covers LLMs,language,cognition and social/ethical critique.
